fields.statement: Change set 'Update github runner to' (cancel stale CI runs, stop re-testing on main) serves no intent yet. Which intent should it serve? / Stopping CI on push to main breaks ship-change: its wait-main step (`rhiza ship check --main --settled`) waits for runs on the merge commit and would time out after 1h on every ship. Since ship-change rebases a PR main has moved past and merges only the head whose checks passed, the merge commit's tree was already tested. How should main be handled? / Should `rhiza ci install`'s workflow template (internal/api/ci.go, for other repos) change too, or only this repo's .github/workflows/ci.yml? / The gh token the agents push with lacks the `workflow` scope, so GitHub rejects any push touching .github/workflows/ci.yml. How does the workflow edit land?
